description: See the pull requests for the current chat's branch in Session Info. Click one to open it in a browser tab.
tagline: The pull requests for the branch your chat is working on

title.ja: ブランチのプルリクエスト

scopes.net:api.github.com: Read public pull requests for the chat's branch when no GitHub account is connected.
scopes.actions:run: Open a pull request in a browser tab when you click it.

optionalScopes.integration:github:read: Use the GitHub account you connected in cmux, so private repositories show too. The app never sees your token.
